correctness.rationale: A complete d²−1 dimensional trace-zero bidegree-(1,1) basis splits into three mutually orthogonal cap-stabilizer sectors. Haar fourth moments and Beta(1,d−1) cap moments give the three exact Rayleigh quotients. Explicit factorizations determine sharp eigenvalue order and the unique crossover; fixed-volume asymptotics are direct substitutions. A separate full-coordinate Gram computation using exact fractions passed 42 cases for d=3..8; finite tests are corroborative only. Boundaries t=0,1 and excluded d=2 are clearly distinguished.

value.rationale: This is a natural first-band restriction problem on compact rank-one symmetric spaces, with a complete spectrum and all multiplicities for every complex dimension at least two. It exactly determines worst observability and reconstruction conditioning, finds a unique dominant-mode exchange at the mean coordinate intensity, and exhibits a universal e^(−1) fixed-volume phase boundary. The result is a substantive structural classification across an infinite family, not a numerical instance or an unmotivated small parameter gain.
